Cujus est αὐτοκεφαλεία[?], & Imperii Majestas; &
inferiores omnes Magistratus universam illam
quâ apud populum pollent potestatem suam ac-
ceptam ferunt, ὡς δι᾽ αὐτῆς πεμπόμενοι[?], 1 Pet. 2. 13.

page.notes: Left strip is the edge of the neighbouring page, not transcribed. Right-margin section marks "I." (beside "In statu popu-") and "2." (beside "Majestas est penes Optimates") are printed in the margin. Greek is uncertain in several places (marked [?]). The initial letter of "utem" is cut off at the line edge. The "2." in "1 Pet. 2. 13." is hard to read in the scan. The catchword "præ" is printed at the foot, and the text ends with "possunt habere" above it.
